candidates.decision_relevance: Would let the analyses compare rebounds with renewed weakness using the actual path and ordering, rather than weekly endpoints or mismatched rolling windows.
candidates.evidence_reference: Multiple weekly reviews report aggregate returns and qualitative path descriptions but lack underlying hourly observations; daily reviews also note that some short-window API windows have too few samples or no elapsed span.
candidates.metric_name: BTC, ETH, and ETH/BTC hourly price observations
candidates.missing_history_problem: Without aligned hourly history, the duration and magnitude of rebounds, deterioration timing, and persistence across the reviewed weeks cannot be tested consistently.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether weak or constructive breadth persisted, broadened, or reversed alongside price and relative performance, helping distinguish endpoint conditions from sustained participation changes.
candidates.evidence_reference: The reviews repeatedly cite missing W44/W45 breadth sequences; daily analyses identify available breadth as point-in-time, filtered-universe proxies with changing membership, while canonical breadth is unconfirmed.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped constituent breadth observations with universe and membership identifiers
candidates.missing_history_problem: Point-in-time counts cannot establish breadth persistence or sequence, and changing membership prevents reliable comparison across captures without the associated universe definition.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would reveal whether reported BTC/ETH flow divergence or outflows persisted, reversed, or preceded price and breadth changes; single-session rows cannot resolve those alternatives.
candidates.evidence_reference: Several daily reviews have only the latest settled session, while weekly reviews note missing W44 flow rows or rely on earlier weeks' settlements.
candidates.metric_name: Daily settled BTC and ETH ETF flow totals
candidates.missing_history_problem: Sparse settled observations do not establish multi-session flow direction, persistence, or timing relative to the reviewed price moves.
